scripts.lint: cd backend && cargo clippy -- -D warnings && cd ../frontend && bun run lint && cd .. && node scripts/i18n-scan.mjs --ci
scripts.format: cd backend && cargo fmt && cd .. && bunx prettier --write "*.{json,md,yml,yaml}" "docs/**/*.md"
scripts.format:check: cd backend && cargo fmt --check && cd .. && bunx prettier --check "*.{json,md,yml,yaml}" "docs/**/*.md"
scripts.test: cd backend && cargo test && cd ../frontend && bun run test
scripts.build: cd backend && cargo build && cd ../frontend && bun run build
